journalType.description: Discriminator folding the former dedicated journal-entry families into this single GLTransaction schema. 'manual' is the default general-journal entry; 'ar-invoice'/'ap-invoice' are sales/purchase journal postings; 'bank' is a bank-statement-derived posting; 'closing' carries the folded ClosingEntry fields (year-end closing); 'intercompany' carries the folded IntercompanyTransaction detection fields.
journalType.title: Journal Type

closingEntryType.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): classification of the closing entry, folded from ClosingEntry.entryType. Per.
closingEntryType.title: Closing Entry Type

fiscalYearId.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): FK to the FiscalYear this closing entry belongs to, folded from ClosingEntry.fiscalYearId. Per.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

approvalStatus.description: Closing group (journalType='closing'): lifecycle state of the closing entry, folded from ClosingEntry.approvalStatus. draft -> pending-approval -> approved -> posted; or posted -> reversed. Per.
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

sourceAdministrationId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the source administration the transaction was booked in, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.sourceAdministrationId.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source Administration ID

counterpartyEntityId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the detected or asserted counterparty entity (administration), folded from IntercompanyTransaction.counterpartyEntityId.
counterpartyEntityId.title: Counterparty Entity ID

detectionMethod.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): how the transaction was identified as intercompany, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.detectionMethod.
detectionMethod.title: Detection Method

detectionConfidence.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): confidence of the detection; label-based defaults to medium pending operator confirmation. Folded from IntercompanyTransaction.detectionConfidence.
detectionConfidence.title: Detection Confidence

isMatched.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): whether the transaction has been included in a match, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.isMatched.
isMatched.title: Is Matched

matchId.description: Intercompany group (journalType='intercompany'): FK to the IntercompanyMatch the transaction belongs to, folded from IntercompanyTransaction.matchId.
matchId.title: Match ID
